title: Hearty Burgundy French Beef Skillet
description: A buttery and shaggy French dish featuring candied peel and robata-grilled beef, cooked in a cast-iron skillet, this recipe is ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly and perfect for a cozy night in. The combination of flavors and textures will leave you feeling warm and satisfied.
instructions: Preheat the robata grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the beef strips with salt and black pepper.
Grill the beef strips for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked to desired level of doneness.
In a large cast-iron skillet, melt 2 tablespoons of butter over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion to the skillet and cook until caramelized, stirring occasionally.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the candied peel, burgundy wine, and beef broth to the skillet, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes, or until the liquid has reduced slightly.
Add the grilled beef strips to the skillet and stir to combine with the sauce.
Reduce heat to low and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the beef is coated in the sauce.
